description: What a Celestia node operator has to know and do for each consensus app version, from the official release notes: required OS and glibc, binary and multiplexer changes, config changes, KMS and signer changes, pruning, Fibre setup. Official text relayed as published, not a summary; for a version the official page does not cover yet (the newest), the Upgrade Notice of the latest stable celestia-app release. Give from_version (the version you run now) and to_version to get every version in between, only to_version for one version, or nothing for the newest. Celestia only. Which version mainnet runs now and where the upgrade signal stands: get_celestia_upgrade_status.

detail.description: full: the official text; outline: only the section headings of each version

from_version.description: The app version you run now, e.g. 7 or v7; notes cover every version after it

to_version.description: The app version you are moving to, e.g. 10; the newest held if left out

name: get_operator_upgrade_notes
